'''2012 Bespin Regionals Jim Li LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' jimli
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
